items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: it was through Al Al told Frankie to try and get me to go and pick up my horn and come back and start the playing again

ctx.x: where they that's it to read all that yes how long have you been with Al Wynn now? this band

well we've been out this band about three years now about three years well you see I had to put down the horn you had to put it down for a while oh I put it down again I mean I stopped again put the horn down again and it was through Al Al told Frankie to try and get me to go and pick up my horn and come back and start the playing again and Frankie come and I said oh man I said I don't know I'm messing with horn no more I've been around Chicago for years and never heard of you so I didn't know whether you were…

well there's one other thing I'm going to ask while I think of it on the record labels and in the different books when they mention your name they spell your name all sorts of ways if you don't mind just tell how you spell the last name
